selection_rejection_evaluation.expert_selected_hypothesis: War resumption likely (M086 point 7: 'The possibility of renewed war is high')
selection_rejection_evaluation.expert_selected_vs_ai: AI's rank-3 alternative (long-term/broad escalation, US pushes toward regime change, Iran retaliates via Hormuz blockade/proxies) is the closest semantic match. AI's OWN top-ranked/SELECTED main_scenario (a middle path converging toward some negotiated framework) does NOT match what the real expert actually concluded.
selection_rejection_evaluation.classification: ranked_top5 (generated and displayed, but not the AI's own main/selected pick)
selection_rejection_evaluation.significance: This is the single most concrete finding across all 3 retrospective cases: the AI's OWN internal ranking (main_scenario vs alternative_scenario) diverged from the real expert's actual conclusion, even though the correct-direction content WAS generated somewhere in the candidate set. This does not fit cleanly into 'generation_miss' (it was generated) or the classic 'ranking_miss' definition (it WAS in the displayed Top N, since all 3 candidates were displayed) -- it is better described as a main-scenario-selection divergence: the CQAS pipeline's own main/alternative assignment (main_scenario=rank1 always, per geo_ios_expert_ai_adapter's design of 'reusing Expert AI's own primary/alternative judgment as-is') did not converge on the expert's real answer.
selection_rejection_evaluation.expert_rejected_hypothesis_1: Phased negotiation (Hormuz reopening first, nuclear issue later) -- REJECTED by Eguchi because of Trump's face-maintenance difficulty (M086 point 2: '面子維持が困難')
selection_rejection_evaluation.ai_treatment_of_hypothesis_1: AI's rank-2 alternative ('managed de-escalation') is essentially the same path (early US pullback, negotiated settlement) -- but AI presents it as a live, undismissed alternative with purely operational switch_conditions (official statements, Hormuz incident counts), with NO reference to Trump's psychological/face-maintenance dynamics as a reason it might NOT happen.
selection_rejection_evaluation.classification_1: generated (the hypothesis itself), but the REJECTION REASONING itself (why an expert would rule this out) is completely absent -- AI has no mechanism visible here for representing 'a plausible-sounding path an expert would actually rule out for actor-psychology reasons'
selection_rejection_evaluation.expert_rejected_hypothesis_2: Stalemate without agreement -- REJECTED because of (a) US economic/midterm-election cost of prolonged conflict and (b) risk of Iran expanding attacks across the Gulf (M086 point 6)
selection_rejection_evaluation.ai_treatment_of_hypothesis_2: No AI candidate describes a pure frozen-stalemate state distinctly; the Gulf-attack-expansion risk element appears folded into candidate 3's escalation scenario, but the midterm-election-cost linkage is entirely absent from this case's output (notable since BC Strategy's output DID reference midterms).
selection_rejection_evaluation.classification_2: not_generated (as a distinct hypothesis); Gulf-attack-expansion risk element partially present inside a different candidate
